meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介生成产品发布与宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有产品链接或营销文案,想快速做出发布宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product link or brief and need a launch video fast.

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简短需求,按步骤做成产品发布/推广视频:先抓取素材、定设计系统、写分镜与脚本,再逐帧搭建,最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4。设置、分镜、终渲三步会先请你确认。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布或揭晓某个产品时触发,任何商业网址默认走这里;网站导览/展示类需求也归它。意图不明确时先转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品网址做成一支发布视频
say.note: 先抓取页面素材,再进入分镜与设计

say.text: 这是我写好的推广脚本,照它做一支视频
say.note: 脚本原文会保存,再据此规划分镜

say.text: 给我们公司首页做一支网站导览视频
say.note: 按网站原样展示的路线处理

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch or promo video: captures assets, picks a design system, writes storyboard and script, builds frames, then renders renders/video.mp4. Steps 0, 3, 6 wait for sign-off.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; it's the default route for any commercial URL. Website tours and showcases route here too. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this product URL into a launch video
say_en.note: Captures the page first, then storyboard and design

say_en.text: Here's my promo script — make a video from it
say_en.note: Saves the script verbatim, then plans the storyboard

say_en.text: Make a site tour video for our company homepage
say_en.note: Handled as a show-it-as-is site tour
